"""Snake game entry point: rendering, input handling and the main loop."""

import sys

import pygame

import config as C
from game import Game, UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT

DIR_KEYS = {
    pygame.K_UP: UP, pygame.K_w: UP,
    pygame.K_DOWN: DOWN, pygame.K_s: DOWN,
    pygame.K_LEFT: LEFT, pygame.K_a: LEFT,
    pygame.K_RIGHT: RIGHT, pygame.K_d: RIGHT,
}


def draw_text(surface, text, size, pos, color=C.COLORS["text"], align="center"):
    img = pygame.font.SysFont(None, size).render(text, True, color)
    rect = img.get_rect()
    setattr(rect, {"center": "center", "left": "topleft", "right": "topright"}[align], pos)
    surface.blit(img, rect)


def draw_hud(surface, game):
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, C.COLORS["hud"], (0, 0, C.WIDTH, C.HUD_HEIGHT))
    draw_text(surface, f"Score: {game.score}", 26, (12, C.HUD_HEIGHT // 2), align="left")
    draw_text(surface, game.difficulty["name"], 26, (C.WIDTH // 2, C.HUD_HEIGHT // 2), C.COLORS["dim"])
    draw_text(surface, f"Length: {len(game.snake.body)}", 26, (C.WIDTH - 12, C.HUD_HEIGHT // 2), align="right")


def draw_board(surface, game):
    surface.fill(C.COLORS["bg"])
    for x in range(C.COLS):
        for y in range(C.ROWS):
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, C.COLORS["grid"],
                             (x * C.CELL, C.HUD_HEIGHT + y * C.CELL, C.CELL, C.CELL), 1)
    if game.food:
        fx, fy = game.food
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, C.COLORS["food"],
                         (fx * C.CELL + 3, C.HUD_HEIGHT + fy * C.CELL + 3, C.CELL - 6, C.CELL - 6),
                         border_radius=4)
    for i, (x, y) in enumerate(game.snake.body):
        color = C.COLORS["snake_head"] if i == 0 else C.COLORS["snake_body"]
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, color,
                         (x * C.CELL + 1, C.HUD_HEIGHT + y * C.CELL + 1, C.CELL - 2, C.CELL - 2),
                         border_radius=3)


def draw_menu(surface):
    surface.fill(C.COLORS["bg"])
    draw_text(surface, "SNAKE", 64, (C.WIDTH // 2, C.WINDOW_HEIGHT // 4))
    draw_text(surface, "Select difficulty (1-4):", 30, (C.WIDTH // 2, C.WINDOW_HEIGHT // 2 - 20))
    y = C.WINDOW_HEIGHT // 2 + 30
    for key, d in C.DIFFICULTIES.items():
        draw_text(surface, f"[{key}] {d['name']}  ({d['speed']} cells/s)", 26,
                  (C.WIDTH // 2, y), C.COLORS["dim"])
        y += 34
    draw_text(surface, "Arrows/WASD move - P pause - ESC quit", 22,
              (C.WIDTH // 2, C.WINDOW_HEIGHT - 30), C.COLORS["dim"])


def draw_veil(surface, alpha):
    veil = pygame.Surface((C.WIDTH, C.HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    veil.fill((0, 0, 0, alpha))
    surface.blit(veil, (0, C.HUD_HEIGHT))


def draw_pause(surface):
    draw_veil(surface, 120)
    draw_text(surface, "PAUSED - [P] Resume", 36, (C.WIDTH // 2, C.HUD_HEIGHT + C.HEIGHT // 2))


def draw_overlay(surface, game):
    draw_veil(surface, 160)
    cy = C.HUD_HEIGHT + C.HEIGHT // 2
    draw_text(surface, "YOU WIN!" if game.won else "GAME OVER", 54, (C.WIDTH // 2, cy - 60))
    draw_text(surface, f"Final score: {game.score}", 30, (C.WIDTH // 2, cy))
    draw_text(surface, "[R] Restart   [M] Menu   [ESC] Quit", 24, (C.WIDTH // 2, cy + 45), C.COLORS["dim"])


def run():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((C.WIDTH, C.WINDOW_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("Snake")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()

    state = "menu"  # menu | playing | paused | gameover
    game = None
    acc = 0.0

    while True:
        dt = clock.tick(C.FPS) / 1000.0
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                pygame.quit()
                sys.exit()
            if event.type != pygame.KEYDOWN:
                continue
            if state == "menu":
                if event.unicode in C.DIFFICULTIES:
                    game = Game(event.unicode)
                    acc = 0.0
                    state = "playing"
                elif event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                    pygame.quit()
                    sys.exit()
            elif state == "playing":
                if event.key in DIR_KEYS:
                    game.snake.turn(DIR_KEYS[event.key])
                elif event.key == pygame.K_p:
                    state = "paused"
                elif event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                    state = "menu"
            elif state == "paused":
                if event.key == pygame.K_p:
                    state = "playing"
                elif event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                    state = "menu"
            elif state == "gameover":
                if event.key == pygame.K_r:
                    game.reset()
                    acc = 0.0
                    state = "playing"
                elif event.key == pygame.K_m:
                    state = "menu"
                elif event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                    pygame.quit()
                    sys.exit()

        if state == "playing" and game is not None:
            acc += dt
            interval = 1.0 / game.speed
            while acc >= interval:
                game.update()
                acc -= interval
                if game.game_over:
                    state = "gameover"
                    acc = 0.0
                    break

        if state == "menu":
            draw_menu(screen)
        else:
            draw_board(screen, game)
            draw_hud(screen, game)
            if state == "paused":
                draw_pause(screen)
            elif state == "gameover":
                draw_overlay(screen, game)
        pygame.display.flip()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()
